h1: China visa-free travel for British citizens: what you need to know
title: China Visa-Free for British Citizens Until 31 Dec 2026 | UVS
description: British citizens can visit China visa-free for up to 30 days until 31 December 2026. Here is who qualifies, what it covers and when you still need a visa.
intro: Since 17 February 2026, British passport holders can visit mainland China without a visa for up to 30 days. China visa-free entry is a big change for UK travellers, but it has limits, and it is currently due to end on 31 December 2026.

sections.heading: What does China visa-free entry cover?
sections.text:
Holders of ordinary British passports can enter mainland China without a visa for up to 30 days for:
- Business, including meetings and trade fairs
- Tourism
- Visiting family and friends
- Exchanges
- Transit

sections.heading: When do you still need a China visa?
sections.text:
You still need a visa if you:
- Plan to stay longer than 30 days on a single visit
- Are going to work, study or report as a journalist
- Are travelling on a passport that isn't covered, for example if you live in the UK on an Indian, Pakistani or Nigerian passport
- Are travelling after 31 December 2026 and the policy hasn't been extended

sections.heading: Planning trips for 2027
sections.text: The China visa-free policy for British citizens currently runs until 31 December 2026. China has extended similar policies before, but there is no guarantee. If you're planning a trip for early 2027, check the latest position before you book, and allow time to apply for a visa if you need one.

sections.heading: How we can help
sections.text: We arrange Chinese visas for UK residents who need them, including business (M), tourist (L), family (Q and S), work (Z) and student (X) visas. Our online China visa form reads your passport details automatically and lists exactly which documents your visa type needs.

sections.heading: What to carry when you travel
sections.text: Even without a visa, take your passport (valid for at least six months), your return or onward ticket, and details of where you’re staying. Border officers can ask to see them. If you plan to work, study or stay longer than 30 days, you still need a visa.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a visa for China?
faqs.a: Not for visits of up to 30 days for tourism, business, family visits, exchanges or transit, until 31 December 2026.

faqs.q: Can I work in China on visa-free entry?
faqs.a: No. Working in China needs a Z visa and a work permit.

faqs.q: Is China visa-free entry for British citizens permanent?
faqs.a: No. It’s currently due to end on 31 December 2026. Check before you plan trips for 2027.
